value.title: Phase 1: live-only hot path + bounded retention
value.summary: One coder, tasks in order, every assertion pinned to a backpressure row.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Work top to bottom; stop-and-ask o-prime on anything outside the fence.

value.title: Hot path: implement a live-only depth query (WHERE state IN ('pending','running') OR (state='failed' AND NOT terminal)) served by jobs_live_dedupe_idx / jobs_revivable_idx; route report_progress and GET /status through it; keep the full GROUP BY available behind an explicit `--history` flag on status if anyone wants it; fix the stale comment at jobs.rs:558-560
value.success: plan test green; red with old SQL
value.receipt: queue plan 3/3; daemon progress + snapshot 1/1 each; CLI status 4/4 on dedicated test postmaster

value.title: Retention: `indexing.job_retention_days` (default 1); `purge_done_jobs(older_than, batch)` in the store; a daemon sweep at boot and every N ticks (reuse the reconciler pattern in boot.rs:632 / worktrees.rs); receipt in /status + one log line per purge with counts
value.receipt: store retention 3/3; status/log 2/2; cadence 1/1; config 1/1 on dedicated :5434 postmaster where applicable

value.title: Mint-time prevention of a second job under a failed non-terminal key (row 123): extend the ON CONFLICT / dedupe path or add a partial unique index covering failed-non-terminal — stop-and-ask if it needs a migration
value.receipt: failed owner revives pending and claimable; attempts+parks reset; running preserved; terminal history mints fresh row; state/attempts/parks mutations red; 13 focused tests green on :5434

value.title: Gate + PR with both mutations and the EXPLAIN in the body
value.receipt: harness checks green on :5434; PR #98 opened; implementation head CI gate passed in 5m22s

value.title: With o-prime after the bounce: one-off purge of today's ~1.01M done rows (o-prime runs it, batched), then the four prod measurements; receipts into ac-0005
